## What this proves

A REAL Driftwood driver subject — name / emails / phones / `pii_drv_cdl_number` —
is seeded so its PII lands on EVERY tier (domain rows, vault, aud_event, the
driver load-count rollup, oban job args, the audit/impersonation chain from a
reveal, and the registered `non_pii!` carve-out). Then `Samen.Erasure.shred/2`
runs, and the destruction oracle
`mix samen.verify.no_plaintext_pii --subject <uuid> --tiers all` is run exactly as
an auditor would (a separate OS process) and asserted to EXIT 0. Both rollup arms
(rebuild + suppress) are exercised; the audit chain is proven to still VERIFY
post-shred while the driver is unrecoverable; every red path flips the oracle; and
an anti-tautology sabotage is caught then reverted.
